Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id := '';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0172');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 -- there cannot be situation where the
 -- chapter_id is not there but the collection
 -- date is there
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
/* if :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id is null
 then
 message('Unit has not been checked-in...No chapter id');
 end if; */
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from pt_batch_det
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and (exp_result is not null or exp_absorbance is not null) ;
 

 if temp_count = 0
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0291');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :GLOBAL.popup_error := 'N';
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_2.coll_Date is not null
 then
 begin
 if trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) > trunc(sysdate)
 then
 show_error('0060');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 

 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date);
 if temp_count != 1
 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('1145');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: PERFORM_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_inter_code VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_coll_date date;
 temp_chapter_id VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_test_id VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_old_result_code VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_new_result_code VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_return_val VARCHAR2(80);
 temp_cut_off VARCHAR2(6);
begin
/* Void type 'R' for Proficiency testing expected results */ 
 begin
 temp_unit_id := :pt_batch_det.unit_id;
 temp_chapter_id := :pt_batch_det.chapter_id;
 temp_test_id := :pt_batch_det.test_id;
 temp_old_result_code := :pt_batch_det.exp_result;
 temp_new_result_code := :ctrl_blk_5.new_result_code;
 temp_cut_off := :ctrl_blk_5.new_cutoff;
 


 insert into test_voids
 ( unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_seq_no,
 test_id, result_status_1,
 tb_id, test_chapter_id, 
 absorbance, 
 testing_lab_code, insert_dats,
 insert_user_id, void_type, void_reason_code,
 void_dats, void_user_id)
 values
 ( :pt_batch_det.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date, :global.chapter_id,
 :pt_batch_det.test_seq_no, :pt_batch_det.test_id, 
 :pt_batch_det.exp_result,
 :pt_batch_det.batch_id,
 :global.chapter_id, 
 :pt_batch_det.exp_absorbance, 
 :global.user_testing_lab_code,
 :pt_batch_det.insert_date, :pt_batch_det.insert_user_id, 'R',
 :ctrl_blk_5.void_reason_code, sysdate, :banner.user_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in test_voids');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :pt_batch_det.exp_absorbance := :ctrl_blk_5.new_absorbance;
 :pt_batch_det.exp_result := :ctrl_blk_5.new_result_code;
 :pt_batch_det.exp_cut_off := :ctrl_blk_5.new_cutoff;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 end if;
end;
